name: ernd
long_description:
ernd is the card for companies that pay for AI, with 4% back on AI spend and 2% on everything else planned for launch. We pool startups’ purchasing power to negotiate discounts, higher usage limits and priority support from AI providers. In our first 48hrs, we onboarded 10 startups and landed 5 vendor partnerships. 

We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions.
one_liner: The credit card for companies that pay for AI

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: CEO of ernd. At Bridgewater’s AIA Labs, built a profitable forecasting system run by AI agents. Won 3 trading competitions, including UChicago. In high school, built a business monetizing Instagram theme pages, including dog pages and baseball highlights and brought it to over $50K in revenue. On leave from Penn, where he studied computer science and math.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Nikhil is the co-founder and CTO at ernd. Previously, he worked as a software engineer for IMC Trading improving data infrastructure, was the first intern on the stablecoin team at Ripple securing payments on RLUSD, and improved RLHF methods through research at the Wharton school. In high school, Nikhil developed many mobile and VR games, garnering over 15,000 downloads. He was a CS student at UPenn before dropping out.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: COO of ernd. Previously founded an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions and worked at a Series A fintech startup building AI agents for finance. Co-founded ARCodeKids, a nonprofit that raised nearly $600K, including $100K from Microsoft Philanthropies, to scale computer science enrollment in Arkansas. On leave from Penn, where I studied finance and AI.
